title: claudex implementation report artifact, version 1
description: The lead's report after an IMPLEMENT_STEP or FIX turn: the files it changed, where it diverged from the agreed plan, and notes. The coordinator owns commit and tree creation and runs the authoritative test gate, so this report carries no agent-authored commit SHAs or test verdicts; that evidence is recorded separately.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this report is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Disclosed local human/agent dialogue that changed requirements this turn; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only when an unresolved choice must escalate to the human.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

files_changed.description: Repository-relative paths the lead changed this turn (advisory; the coordinator's tree diff is authoritative).

deviations_from_plan.description: Where the implementation diverged from the agreed plan and why.
